title: N. C. from Hastings, UK – Clown 1 August 2025
quote:
***It was one of the most beautiful, playful and deep experiences I’ve had. Vivian and Ali created a space for us to open up, play, grow and laugh. As a result, I love clowning, I love meeting other other clowns and doing some clownery with them.***

***I’m carrying this deep lightness and playfulness in my heart.***

***Now, I see clowns everywhere.***
